content:
Day One: Arrival in Tokyo  
Thou shalt land at Narita Airport ere the sun doth rise.  
Take the swift train to thy lodging in Shibuya.  
Explore the neon streets as night doth fall.  
Visit the Hachiko statue and taste takoyaki from a street vendor.  

Day Two: Temples and Gardens  
Morning thou shalt wander Meiji Shrine.  
Afternoon thou shalt stroll through Shinjuku Gyoen.  
Evening thou shalt view the city from Tokyo Tower.  

Day Three: Journey to Kyoto  
Board the shinkansen at dawn and ride to Kyoto.  
Upon arrival thou shalt check into a ryokan near Gion.  
Afternoon thou shalt wander the historic streets of Gion.  
Evening thou shalt witness a geisha performance.  

Day Four: Sacred Sites  
Morning thou shalt visit Kinkaku ji the Golden Pavilion.  
Afternoon thou shalt explore the rock garden of Ryoan ji.  
Evening thou shalt walk the Philosopher's Path under cherry blossoms.  

Day Five: Nara Excursion  
Take a short train to Nara where deer roam free.  
Visit Todai ji temple housing the great Buddha.  
Return to Kyoto for a quiet night.  

Day Six: Osaka Adventures  
Travel to Osaka by rapid rail.  
Morning thou shalt tour Osaka Castle.  
Afternoon thou shalt indulge in street food at Dotonbori.  
Evening thou shalt enjoy the vibrant nightlife of the city.  

Day Seven: Hiroshima and Miyajima  
Early train to Hiroshima to see the Peace Memorial Park.  
Afternoon ferry to Miyajima island to view the iconic Itsukushima shrine.  
Return to Osaka for thy final night.  

Day Eight: Return and Departure  
Morning thou shalt take the shinkansen back to Tokyo.  
Afternoon thou shalt purchase souvenirs in Akihabara.  
Evening thou shalt depart from Narita with memories of Japan.
